required_conditions_for_publication_qual: No YouTube or other streaming video playing anywhere on the machine.
No active browser video playback (any tab, any browser).
No heavy background workloads (other builds, other model inference, large file transfers, backups, indexing).
No Windows Update / install activity in progress or scheduled to start during the run window.
No concurrent AI workloads of any kind (no other model loaded anywhere on the host).

Fixed power mode: the host's OS power plan must be set to the same fixed mode for every run of the campaign (recorded in HARDWARE-IDENTITY-STAMP.json at first run; 'Balanced' or 'High performance' is acceptable as long as it never changes mid-campaign -- never 'Power saver' for publication runs, since that mode deliberately throttles and would conflate measurement noise with a real effect).
Fixed runtime/model/expert-store paths: ARGINE_LLAMA_DIR, the model path, and the expert-store cache path must be byte-identical to the Phase-0/R2-11 frozen paths for every run.

Sufficient free RAM before each run: re-use argine.planner.plan() feasibility check (same mechanism as the R2-11 capture driver fix in commit f053059) for the run's configured budget; abort if infeasible.

No thermal throttling if measurable (see hardware_contract.json / cooldown policy below); if CPU temperature/frequency telemetry is unavailable on this host, the conservative fixed-pause cooldown policy (section 23 / below) substitutes for a live telemetry check.
Record CPU temperature/frequency where practical (best-effort; absence must be noted explicitly, not silently omitted).

chrome_policy.requirement: Chrome (and any other browser) MUST be fully closed (not merely minimized, not just video-paused) for every publication-quality run. An idle browser with background tabs can still trigger periodic CPU/network/GC activity (tab throttling is not guaranteed to reach zero) that adds uncontrolled timing noise to a measurement this sensitive.
chrome_policy.exploratory_runs: A run performed with Chrome open may be used only for exploratory/debugging purposes and MUST be tagged non_publication_quality=true in its run record; it is never eligible to be aggregated into the primary/secondary statistics used for the R2-12 decision rule.

pre_run_self_check: The pre-run gate (execution_plan.json) must verify as many of the above as are machine-checkable (power mode via OS API if accessible, free RAM via argine.hardware.detect(), no concurrent writer lock, paths). Conditions that are not machine-checkable (no YouTube playing, Chrome fully closed) are operator attestations recorded in each run's record as a boolean 'operator_attested_clean_environment' field, not silently assumed.
